chakras.name: Bindu
chakras.subtitle: The Origin
chakras.shaktiName: Lalita Mahatripurasundari herself / Rajarajeshvari — presiding consciousness of Avarana 9 (Sarvanandamaya Chakra). The Bindu IS the Shakti. Three sub-bindus at center: Kurukulla (red, feminine), Varahi (white, masculine), and their union (the individual soul).
chakras.mudra: Yoni Mudra — the womb gesture, return to source
chakras.bija: · · · the seed before the seed · · · (no syllable — the Bindu IS the silence that becomes ॐ OM)
chakras.essence: The origin. What everything emanates from.
chakras.bodyLocation: The origin point — before all systems, before all positions
chakras.joinedBy: Shakti Name: "Lalita … presiding consciousness of Avarana 9" → Mahātripurasundarī, kp 102

chakras.name: Muladhara
chakras.subtitle: Where the Body Meets the Earth
chakras.mudra: Kshobha Mudra — the readiness gesture, entering the three worlds
chakras.bija: लं · LAM (the earth seed — yellow square, four petals, sealed and sounding)
chakras.essence: The ground you stand on. Literally and in every other sense.
chakras.bodyLocation: Base of spine / Earth beneath feet
chakras.joinedBy: "10 Siddhi Devis" → Mandala Shakti Family = Siddhi, kp 1–10

chakras.name: Svadhisthana
chakras.subtitle: The Tide Below
chakras.shaktiName: 8 Matrika Devis (Avarana 1, middle ring of Bhupura) — Brahmi, Maheshvari, Kaumari, Vaishnavi, Varahi, Mahendri, Chamunda, Mahalakshmi. The divine mothers of all emotional states.
chakras.mudra: Kshobha Mudra — Avarana 1's mudra, shared with Muladhara and Manipura. The readiness gesture, entering the three worlds. The walker still stands on bounded earth; the readiness now extends inward through the emotional body.
chakras.bija: वं · VAM (the water seed — silver crescent, six petals, flow finding its shape)
chakras.essence: Where desire lives. Not what you want — the fact that you want at all.
chakras.bodyLocation: Sacral center / Below navel
chakras.joinedBy: "8 Matrika Devis … Brahmi … Mahalakshmi" → Shakti Family = Matrika, kp 11–18

chakras.name: Manipura
chakras.subtitle: The Sealed Chamber
chakras.shaktiName: 10 Mudra Shaktis (Avarana 1, inner ring of Bhupura) — Sarva Sankshobhini, Sarva Vidravini, Sarvakarshini, Sarva Vashankari, Sarvonmadini, Sarva Mahankusha, Sarva Khechari, Sarva Beeja, Sarva Yoni, Sarva Trikhanda. The sacred gesture powers that shape will into form.
chakras.mudra: Kshobha Mudra — Avarana 1's mudra, shared with Muladhara and Svadhisthana. The readiness gesture, completing the three-ring traversal of the bounded earth. The same readiness that touched the ground (Muladhara) and met the emotions (Svadhisthana) now stands inside the fire.
chakras.bija: रं · RAM (the fire seed — red triangle pointing down, ten petals, the city of jewels sounding)
chakras.essence: Your fire. The center that transforms what enters you into what you become.
chakras.bodyLocation: Solar plexus / Navel center
chakras.joinedBy: "10 Mudra Shaktis … Sarva Sankshobhini … Sarva Trikhanda" → Shakti Family = Mudra, kp 19–28

chakras.name: Anahata
chakras.subtitle: The Sound That Was Always Playing
chakras.mudra: Dravini Mudra — Avarana 2's mudra, shared with Sahasrara. The melting gesture. Fulfillment of all desires through release rather than grasping. The heart receives the 16 attractors not by holding them but by becoming porous to them.
chakras.bija: यं · YAM
chakras.essence: The center where love lives. Not romantic love. The kind that doesn't need a reason.
chakras.bodyLocation: Heart center / Chest
chakras.joinedBy: "16 Nitya Kalas — Kamakarshini through Sharirakarshini" → kp 29–44

chakras.name: Vishuddha
chakras.subtitle: The Passage
chakras.shaktiName: 4 Anangas (Avarana 3, first half of 8-Petal Lotus) — Ananga Kusuma (flower of the non-bodied), Ananga Mekhala (girdle of the non-bodied), Ananga Madana (love-madness of the non-bodied), Ananga Madanatura (love-fever of the non-bodied). Speech as bloom, binding, madness, fever — the creative half of the 8 Anangas.
chakras.mudra: Akarshana Mudra — the attraction force that draws truth into form through speaking
chakras.bija: हं · HAM
chakras.essence: The narrowest passage in the body. Where breath becomes voice. Where the interior meets what is not interior.
chakras.bodyLocation: Between the jaw and the collarbones — the bottleneck by design

chakras.name: Ajna
chakras.subtitle: The Seer That Sees
chakras.shaktiName: 4 Anangas (Avarana 3, second half of 8-Petal Lotus) — Ananga Rekha (line of the non-bodied), Ananga Vegini (speed of the non-bodied), Anangankusha (goad of the non-bodied), Ananga Malini (garland of the non-bodied). Perception as line, speed, direction, completion — the directional half of the 8 Anangas.
chakras.mudra: Akarshana Mudra — Avarana 3's mudra, shared with Vishuddha. The attraction force, now turned inward: the same magnetic gesture that drew non-bodied truth into bodied speech at the throat now draws non-bodied seeing into bodied recognition at the third eye. One gesture, two directions of operation.
chakras.bija: ओं · OM
chakras.essence: Inner sight. The ability to see without using your eyes.
chakras.bodyLocation: Behind the forehead — not on the surface, slightly inside, in the space where the brain sits directly behind the brow ridge
chakras.joinedBy: "Ananga Rekha, Vegini, Anangankusha, Ananga Malini" → kp 49–52

chakras.name: Sahasrara
chakras.subtitle: The Aperture
chakras.shaktiName: Tripureshi — presiding consciousness of Avarana 2 (Sarva Asha Paripuraka Chakra, the 16-Petal Lotus). "She who fulfills all desires." Not a giver but the recognition that the crown was never separate from the source of all fulfillment. At Anahata the 16 Akarshana Devis (her residents) drew the complete spectrum of experience to the heart. At Sahasrara, Tripureshi reveals herself as the consciousness behind the drawing. Yogini: Gupta (the Hidden).
chakras.mudra: Dravini Mudra — desire fulfillment through dissolution of the one who desires
chakras.bija: · · · silence · · · (the syllable before syllables)
chakras.essence: Connection. Not to something above you — to everything that includes you.
chakras.bodyLocation: Top of the head · the fontanelle · the sealed-over aperture
chakras.joinedBy: "Tripureshi — presiding consciousness of Avarana 2" — the presiding form is not one of the 102 seats; the whole ring

chakras.name: Shadow
chakras.subtitle: The Corridor
chakras.mudra: The threshold itself is the gesture — the press-and-hold that opens the corridor
chakras.bija: · · · the word you offer to the dark · · · (your own voice, the syllable the corridor was waiting for)
chakras.essence: The corridor was never a dead end. It was always leading somewhere.
chakras.bodyLocation: The threshold corridor — between all systems

chakras.name: Soles
chakras.subtitle: Where the Soul Meets the Ground
chakras.mudra: Vasya Mudra — the 4th avarana mudra that brings everything into relationship
chakras.bija: LAM · लं — Mirror frequency of Muladhara
chakras.essence: Your feet. The bottom terminal of everything you are.
chakras.bodyLocation: Soles of feet

chakras.name: Forge
chakras.subtitle: The Sealed Chamber
chakras.mudra: Vasya Mudra — the mantra as the organizing field of the body's center
chakras.bija: RAM · रं — Mirror frequency of Manipura
chakras.essence: Your navel. The scar of the cord that connected you to your mother. Behind the scar: the furnace.
chakras.bodyLocation: Navel / Belly button

chakras.name: Prana
chakras.subtitle: The Open Door
chakras.mudra: Sarvonmadini Mudra — the ecstatic quality of breath when received rather than directed
chakras.bija: VAM · वं — Mirror frequency of Svadhisthana
chakras.essence: Your nose. Where air becomes life the moment it crosses the threshold of your body.
chakras.bodyLocation: Lungs / Breath channel

chakras.name: Hands
chakras.subtitle: Where Love Exits the Body
chakras.mudra: Sarvonmadini Mudra — the intoxicating quality of touch when it lands with full presence
chakras.bija: YAM · यं — Mirror frequency of Anahata
chakras.essence: Your palms. Where the heart reaches into the world and touches it.
chakras.bodyLocation: Palms and fingers

chakras.name: Pulse
chakras.subtitle: The Heartbeat
chakras.mudra: Sarvonmadini Mudra — the heartbeat as the body's original intoxicant, sustaining without effort
chakras.bija: YAM · यं — Mirror frequency of Anahata
chakras.essence: The most consistent rhythm in your body. Not a feeling — a fact.
chakras.bodyLocation: Physical heart — left chest

chakras.name: Sonar
chakras.subtitle: The Speaker
chakras.mudra: Vasya Mudra — speech as the organizing force that brings inner and outer into relationship
chakras.bija: HAM · हं — Mirror frequency of Vishuddha (sending aspect)
chakras.essence: Your mouth as instrument. Not volume — precision.
chakras.bodyLocation: Mouth and vocal cords

chakras.name: Echo
chakras.subtitle: The Listener
chakras.mudra: Mahankusha Mudra — the inner goad that directs what is allowed to enter and stay
chakras.bija: HAM · हं — Mirror frequency of Vishuddha (receiving aspect)
chakras.essence: Your ears. The filter through which the world becomes your world.
chakras.bodyLocation: Ears

chakras.name: Vision
chakras.subtitle: The Mind's Eye
chakras.mudra: Mahankusha Mudra — knowledge that guides the inner vision's trajectory
chakras.bija: OM · ॐ — Mirror frequency of Ajna
chakras.essence: The forehead. Where you see things that aren't in front of you.
chakras.bodyLocation: Forehead / Visual cortex

chakras.name: Axis
chakras.subtitle: The Blink
chakras.mudra: Mahankusha Mudra — the bliss that guides through the between-space of every blink
chakras.bija: OM · ॐ — Mirror frequency of Ajna
chakras.essence: The gateway between your inner world and your outer world. The blink is the switch.
chakras.bodyLocation: Physical eyes

chakras.name: Crow
chakras.subtitle: The Top Terminal
chakras.mudra: Mahankusha Mudra — the inner guide operating through the body's central network
chakras.bija: Silence — Mirror frequency of Sahasrara (no bija, the frequency is silence itself)
chakras.essence: Crown of the skull. What opens when the body pushes past the mind.
chakras.bodyLocation: The entire spine — crown to coccyx

chakras.name: Armin
chakras.subtitle: The Room
chakras.sanskrit: तत् त्वम् असि · Tat Tvam Asi
chakras.shaktiName: Tripura Malini — Garland-maker of the Three Worlds. Threshold between Avaranas 4-6 (Sthithi) and 7-8 (Samhara)
chakras.mudra: Mahankusha Mudra — the great goad completing its work, pointing inward toward the mind
chakras.bija: · · · Tat Tvam Asi · · · (the recognition, not the repetition)
chakras.essence: Wholeness. Not repair — arrival.
chakras.bodyLocation: Full body — the arrival posture, standing

chakras.name: Inception
chakras.subtitle: The Seed
chakras.mudra: Rahasya Mudra — the secret that every beginning contains within it
chakras.bija: · · · the seed you carry · · ·
chakras.essence: What you carry in is what you will find.
chakras.bodyLocation: The beginning-moment — the mind before the first step

chakras.name: Intention
chakras.subtitle: The Whole Picture
chakras.mudra: Rahasya Mudra — the secret steadiness at the center of all creative work
chakras.bija: · · · the whole picture · · ·
chakras.essence: The complete picture, held steady through all the noise.
chakras.bodyLocation: The center of sustained focus — the image held complete

chakras.name: Inspiration
chakras.subtitle: The Pull
chakras.mudra: Rahasya Mudra — the secret that delight knows and difficulty doesn't
chakras.bija: · · · follow · · ·
chakras.essence: The pull that is smarter than the plan.
chakras.bodyLocation: The in-breath of the mind — where excitement precedes effort

chakras.name: Insight
chakras.subtitle: From Inside
chakras.mudra: Rahasya Mudra — the secret clarity that lives beneath all interpretation
chakras.bija: · · · enter · · ·
chakras.essence: The view that is only available from inside.
chakras.bodyLocation: The position-shift — inside the situation rather than above it

chakras.name: Intuition
chakras.subtitle: The Flash
chakras.mudra: Rahasya Mudra — the secret that knowing arrives before evidence
chakras.bija: · · · before the word · · ·
chakras.essence: What arrives before the reasoning starts.
chakras.bodyLocation: The pre-verbal knowing space — what arrives before it becomes a thought

chakras.name: Invention
chakras.subtitle: The New Room
chakras.mudra: Rahasya Mudra — the secret that the complete form already exists before it is built
chakras.bija: · · · the third thing · · ·
chakras.essence: The third thing that appears when two things that have never touched finally meet.
chakras.bodyLocation: The synthesis space — where separate pieces become one whole

chakras.name: Incarnation
chakras.subtitle: You Chose This
chakras.mudra: Rahasya Mudra — the secret that choice and love are the same gesture
chakras.primaryColor: Deep Violet · Midnight Blue · Star Silver
chakras.bija: · · · you chose this · · ·
chakras.essence: You chose the specific material you came to learn.
chakras.bodyLocation: The soul-choice register — the moment of opting in

chakras.name: Innocence
chakras.subtitle: Before Anyone Taught You
chakras.mudra: Rahasya Mudra — the secret that the original knowing was never lost
chakras.bija: · · · before the question · · ·
chakras.essence: The knowing that was there before the first lesson.
chakras.bodyLocation: The pre-conditioning space — what was there before the learning began

chakras.name: Integration
chakras.subtitle: Nothing Was Separate
chakras.shaktiName: Tripura Siddhamba — Destroyer of Poison, presiding Avarana 7
chakras.mudra: Sarva Beeja Mudra — the all-seed gesture, completed knowing taking root
chakras.bija: · · · nothing was separate · · ·
chakras.essence: Nothing was ever separate. The poison was the belief that it was.
chakras.bodyLocation: The whole-self space — where nothing is separate
chakras.joinedBy: "Tripura Siddhamba … presiding Avarana 7" — presiding form, not a seat; the whole ring

chakras.name: Maya
chakras.subtitle: The Construction
chakras.mudra: Sarva Beeja Mudra — the seed recognized, the protection completing its purpose
chakras.bija: · · · no tone — the silence after every seed · · · (Sarva Beeja: all the mantras the walker carried, sounding at once, gone transparent)
chakras.essence: The construction doesn't collapse. It becomes see-through.
chakras.bodyLocation: The inverted Bindu — the mirror of the origin point
chakras.joinedBy: "Kameshvari — 1st Kama Kala Shakti" / Function "of the 8th avarana" → Kāmeśvarī, kp 99

chakras.name: Aatma
chakras.subtitle: The Soul Revealed
chakras.mudra: Sarva Beeja Mudra — the permission slip that opens the E Chakra field
chakras.bija: · · · three seeds sounding as one — Icchā · Jnāna · Kriyā · · · (the heartwood tone is not hummed, it is lived: heartbeat, breath, blink)
chakras.essence: Not something you become. What you discover you always were.
chakras.bodyLocation: The inner triangle — the independent space that stands alone

chakras.name: Ego Reveal
chakras.subtitle: The Hidden Helper
chakras.mudra: Sarva Beeja Mudra — the fire that reveals the seed has always been the whole
chakras.bija: · · · her register was never a syllable — warmth, weight, breath, heartbeat · · · (the tone you have been calling background your whole life)
chakras.essence: The ego was never the enemy. It was her — the connector, wearing Maya.
chakras.bodyLocation: Full system — the revealing perspective where everything is seen as connector
chakras.joinedBy: "Bhagamalini — 3rd Kama Kala Shakti" / Function "of the 8th avarana" → Bhagamālinī, kp 101

chakras.name: Lalita
chakras.subtitle: The Play
chakras.shaktiName: Lalita Mahatripurasundari / Rajarajeshvari — Avarana 9, the Bindu
chakras.mudra: Yoni Mudra — the womb gesture, the return to source completing the circle
chakras.bija: · · · no seed left to sound — laughter · · · (every bija of the walk was her voice; what remains is the one sound made purely for joy)
chakras.essence: Same point. Same love. Same traveling. One difference: she knows.
chakras.bodyLocation: The Bindu — dimensionless, all-encompassing, everywhere and nowhere
